BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving child welfare outcomes; and adding anew section to chapter 74.13 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that outcomes for children and families whoengage with state child welfare agencies can be improved by: (1)Increasing quality, efficiency, and accountability in service deliverysystems; (2) investing in efforts to prevent children and families fromentering the system; and (3) reinvesting savings realized throughprevention efforts.
